title: Birdsong Forest ABC
hook: Branch to branch, the forest answers carefully.
roundStructure: Round 1 lexical-semantic A-Z; Round 2 retrieval-action A-Z; 4+4+4+4+4+4+2 chunks
visualStyle: airy 3D forest storybook, birds and plants, spring green palette, soft sky light, crisp recognizable silhouettes

creativeFingerprint.pointOfView: a child locating forest things by sound and by the silence between sounds
creativeFingerprint.chorusFunction: teach near/far listening and return to the call-answer-hush pattern
creativeFingerprint.round1Grammar: hand-written auditory map; audible targets get honest sound verbs while silent plants and objects are framed as pauses or visual anchors
creativeFingerprint.round2Grammar: near/far or quiet cue -> recall beat -> target -> restrained listening gesture
creativeFingerprint.sectionContrast: Verses stay sparse; chorus widens; retrieval strips back. wood-flute or pizzicato leaf answers between target phrases
creativeFingerprint.signatureColor: wood-flute or pizzicato leaf answers between target phrases
creativeFingerprint.authorialIntent: Compose the forest as a listening map where calls, wing sounds, river noise and deliberate silence reveal distance; non-sounding objects become the quiet spaces between calls.
creativeFingerprint.lyricIdentity: A child listens branch to branch; recurring language uses call, answer, echo, rustle, hush, far, near and between.
imageMotifs: wolf call far beyond the trail
semanticArc: river and trail widen the listening map
evening quiet gathers the final calls
forbiddenGenericLanguage: birds and plants sing back to me
